explanation: It is a ball of mostly iron and nickel, roughly as hot as the surface of the Sun, kept solid by enormous pressure. The outer core around it is liquid.

claims.text: The inner core is the innermost layer of the Earth, at its centre.
The outer core, the mantle and the crust all lie outside the inner core.
Earth's inner core is made mostly of iron and nickel.
The inner core's temperature, estimated at about 5,000 to 6,000 °C, is comparable to the temperature of the Sun's visible surface, about 5,500 °C.
The inner core is solid because of the enormous pressure on it, while the outer core around it is liquid.
